backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and per-user task data with authorization checks and incremental task/subtask ID generation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two UI changes to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base styles and OKLCH color variables supporting light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication state, profile loading, error recovery, and routing to the main task page or onboarding dialog.
frontend/src/components/Auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/Auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first‑time users to submit their name and create a profile.
frontend/src/components/Auth/SignedOutSc: Landing screen for unauthenticated users with feature list and sign‑in button.
frontend/src/components/Error/AccessDeni: Placeholder file for an Access Denied error screen, currently empty.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright information and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Layout/Header.ts: Header showing app branding, user greeting, dark‑mode toggle, avatar, and login/logout button.
frontend/src/components/Shared/ConfirmDi: Reusable confirmation dialog with customizable text and loading state.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/CommandPal: Command palette UI allowing quick task actions like creating, searching, and toggling view.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/DueAlertsB: Displays dismissible alerts for overdue and soon-due tasks based on due dates.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskBulkAc: Bulk action bar enabling completing, archiving, or deleting multiple selected tasks with confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskForm.t: Form for creating or editing tasks with validation, date selection, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskItem.t: List-style task item with status toggles, metadata badges, and delete confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskKanban: Kanban-style card showing task details with actions for updating, archiving, duplicating, and deleting.
Skeleton placeholder UI for loading Kanban task columns.
Renders tasks grouped by status into Kanban columns, each showing task cards and counts. Supports editing and duplicating tasks.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskList.t: Displays a vertical list of tasks or a loading skeleton or empty state. Supports editing and duplicating tasks.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskListSk: Shows placeholder skeleton cards representing loading task list items.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskPage.t: Main task management page handling filters, sorting, metrics, task creation, and switching between list and Kanban views.
frontend/src/components/Tasks/TaskToolba: Provides search, sorting, and filtering controls for the task list, including filter clearing.
Contains task filtering, sorting, and due-date utility functions for computing counts and badges.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useCreateTask.t: React Query mutation hook for creating tasks and invalidating the tasks query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useDeleteTask.t: React Query mutation hook for deleting a task and refreshing the task list afterward.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useTasks.ts: Fetches tasks via React Query with periodic refetching and dependency on actor and identity readiness.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useToggleComple: Mutation hook for toggling task completion by updating its status and invalidating task data.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTask.t: Mutation hook for updating a task’s details and refreshing the tasks query after success.
frontend/src/hooks/tasks/useUpdateTaskSt: Mutation hook for updating a task’s status with backend error handling and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages backend actor creation based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides React Query hooks to fetch and save the authenticated user's profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDarkMode.ts: Manages dark mode state with localStorage persistence and updates the document class accordingly.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling authentication, identity loading, and login flow using AuthClient.
Registers global keyboard shortcuts for creating tasks, focusing search, and opening the command palette.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes using OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
Detects whether an error indicates an authorization failure by matching common permission-related keywords.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeBackendError: Converts backend errors into user-friendly messages, handling strings, Error objects, and common failure patterns.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining color tokens, theme extensions, plugins, and dark mode via class switching.
project_state.json: Contains the project’s versioned state, architectural constraints, known issues, and a list of existing features for a Motoko + React task management app. Also documents upcoming schema changes, multi-user behavior, and UX requirements.
